subject: Overnight security report
body:
Overnight report — Kofi Mensah

Around 23:45 Monday I heard the drinks fridge door and a can being opened. I didn't see who was there, and that time is approximate.

At 00:01 Tuesday, Sandra and I saw a pale figure through the server-room glass. It ran toward the fire stairs; we followed and lost sight of it at 00:03. Neither of us identified a face.

We went to the lobby desk and used the phone for the facilities on-call line from 00:04 to 00:19. That is where we were while trying to get help. I'm putting the times together now rather than trusting the increasingly dramatic versions going round this morning.
title: Overnight security report
